(i)Appplication & Repayment of Loans & Borrowings:

a)The company has not defaulted in repayment of loans or other borrowings or in the payment of interest thereon to any lender during the year.

b)The company has not been declared willful defaulter by any bank or financial institution or government or any government authority.

c)Term loans availed by the company during the year were applied for the purpose for which loans were obtained.

d)On an overall examination of the standalone financial statements of the company, funds raised on short-term basis have, prima facie, not been used during the year for long-term purposes by the company.

e)On an overall examination of the standalone financial statements of the company, the company has not taken any funds from any entity or person on account of or to meet the obligations of its subsidiaries, associates or joint ventures.

timeline.summary: Dishman Carbogen Amcis announced that its Shanghai subsidiary successfully completed an unannounced NMPA GMP inspection with no observations.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹851.4 Cr (+18.9% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹21.74 Cr (-49.5% YoY).

Dishman Carbogen Amcis Limited’s **Shri Gaurangbhai Dave** arranged an earnings conference call on **20th May 2026** at 15:00 hrs (IST) to discuss Q4 FY2025-26 results, with audio available at imdcal.com.
Dishman Carbogen Amcis held its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call on May 20, 2026, discussing strong CDMO performance and a proposed ECB loan.
Dishman Carbogen Amcis scheduled an EGM for June 19, 2026, to seek shareholder approval for increased borrowing limits and a promoter ECB loan.

Dishman Carbogen Amcis held Q1FY27 earnings call on August 17, 2026, reporting revenue of ₹677.64 Cr, PAT loss of ₹57.88 Cr, and announcing new Global CCO Angela Ameriks and promoter ECB plan of up to CHF 200 million.
Dishman Carbogen Amcis informed about a promoter share purchase agreement between Aamanya AG and Adimans Technologies LLP for a 59.32% stake.
Dishman Carbogen Amcis disclosed a Family Settlement Agreement among promoters involving a 59.32% inter-se share transfer and planned public reclassification for certain members.
